scripts.kill-port: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const isWin=process.platform==='win32';let p='';try{p=isWin?execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :3001',{encoding:'utf8'}):execSync('lsof -ti:3001',{encoding:'utf8'})}catch{}const l=p.trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);if(l.length===0){console.log('Port 3001 is free');process.exit(0)}const pid=isWin?l.map(x=>x.trim().split(/\s+/).pop()).filter(Boolean).pop():l.pop();console.log('Killing PID '+pid);isWin?execSync('taskkill /PID '+pid+' /F',{stdio:'inherit'}):execSync('kill -9 '+pid,{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Port 3001 freed')"
